work_dir.description: Base directory for output HTML and graph files

log_dir.description: Directory to store raw log files (.log) used by tools like log2rrd

snmp_interval.description: SNMP polling interval in minutes (must match cron job frequency)

snmp_timeout.description: SNMP timeout in seconds before retrying

snmp_default_authname.description: SNMP community string for devices that don’t specify one

snmp_default_authpass.description: Optional: SNMPv3 auth pass for default auth

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support for host resolution

mail_alert_enabled.description: Enable global email alerts on threshold breaches

html_title.description: Title shown in HTML header for generated pages

html_directory.description: Root HTML output directory (if different from WorkDir)

png_directory.description: PNG graph output directory (if different from WorkDir)

threshold_enabled.description: Enable global threshold warning (applies to all targets)

threshold_value.description: Threshold in bytes for global alerts (applies to all targets)

name.description: Unique identifier for the target (used as key in config)

host.description: IP address or hostname of the device

oid_in.description: SNMP OID for incoming traffic (if_idx.1 -> ifInOctets)

oid_out.description: SNMP OID for outgoing traffic (if_idx.1 -> ifOutOctets)

snmp_community.description: SNMP community string for this device (overrides default)

snmp_version.description: SNMP version for this device ('1', '2c', or '3'). Leave blank to use global default.

page_top.description: HTML header content placed above the graph (e.g., <h2>)

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes per second for auto-scaling (e.g., 10 Mbps = 1,250,000)

with_peak.description: Include peak values in the graph legend (yes/no)

threshold_in.description: Incoming traffic threshold in bytes (0 = disable)

threshold_out.description: Outgoing traffic threshold in bytes (0 = disable)

color_in.description: Color for incoming traffic graph line (e.g., '#00ff00')

color_out.description: Color for outgoing traffic graph line

color_background.description: Background color for this graph’s HTML page

color_text.description: Text color for this graph’s HTML page

html_filename.description: Custom HTML output filename (e.g., 'router1_eth0.html'). Leave blank to auto-generate.

mail_alert_enabled.description: Enable email alerts for this target (overrides global)

mail_alert_recipient.description: Email address to receive alerts for this target

add_options.description: Additional MRTG options not covered above (e.g., {'XSize': '600', 'YSize': '200'})
